hypothesis: Price-derived signals collapsed to 2.9 effective independent strategies because they all transform one series. Earnings surprise is generated by a different process (analyst forecast error) and should be weakly correlated with momentum. Post-earnings announcement drift (Ball-Brown 1968, Bernard-Thomas 1989) is among the most replicated anomalies. Predicting: standalone IC of 0.01-0.03, and more importantly correlation below 0.1 with the existing price book, which would raise effective breadth above 2.9 and is the thing that actually matters for the Sharpe target.
